g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
lca_models.core.models.ImpactCategory
Environmental or social issue of concern in LCIA.
``oriont:ImpactCategory`` = "Class representing environmental issues of concern to which life cycle inventory analysis results may be assigned; for example climate change or acidification." (ISO 14040)
Linked from :class:`ImpactCategoryScore` via ``oriont:assessesImpactCategory``.
Attributes: name: Short identifier (e.g. ``"climate_change"``). description: Human-readable description of the impact category.

lca_models.core.models.ImpactCategoryIndicator
Quantifiable representation of an impact category.
``oriont:ImpactCategoryIndicator`` = "Quantifiable representation of an impact category." (ISO 14040)
Carries the indicator name, unit, and a link to the parent :class:`ImpactCategory`.
Attributes: name: Indicator name (e.g. ``"Global Warming Potential"``). unit: Characterisation unit (e.g. ``"kg CO2 eq"``). impact_category: The :class:`ImpactCategory` this indicator quantifies.

lca_models.core.models.ImpactCategoryScore
Result for a single LCIA impact category.
Typed as ``lcont:ImpactCategoryScore``, which is a ``rdfs:subClassOf ssbd:LifeCycleImpactAssessmentCategorisation``. The ``ssbd_class`` field records the most specific SSbD IRI for this category (e.g. ``"https://w3id.org/ssbd/GlobalWarmingImpactAssessment"``).
Attributes: category_key: Short semantic key (e.g. ``"climate_change_total"``). method_tuple: Full LCIA method identifier string used as the dict key in raw LCIA output. score: Computed LCIA score value. unit: Unit of the score (e.g. ``"kg CO2-Eq"``). ssbd_class: IRI of the SSbD class representing this impact category. note: Set when the LCIA computation returned an empty result. error: Set when the method computation failed.

lca_models.core.models.LCIAResult
Top-level container for the results of one LCIA run.
Attributes: functional_unit: Name of the activity used as the functional unit. foreground_db: Name of the foreground database used for this run. scores: One :class:`ImpactCategoryScore` per evaluated method. summary: Optional metadata summary of the run.

lca_models.core.models.LCIASummary
Metadata summary attached to an :class:`LCIAResult`.
Attributes: total_methods_evaluated: Number of methods for which scores were computed. method_set: Human-readable name of the method family (e.g. ``"EF v3.1"``). functional_unit: Description of the functional unit used. process: Name of the foreground production process. location: Geographic scope (e.g. ``"RER"``).

lca_models.core.models.Location
Geographic scope of an LCA activity or LCIA run.
``oriont:Location`` identifies the country, region, or market scope of a dataset (e.g. ``"GLO"`` for global, ``"RER"`` for Europe, ``"DE"`` for Germany). Linked from :class:`LCIActivityNode` and :class:`LCIASummary` via ``oriont:hasLocation``.
Attributes: code: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or an LCA database region code such as ``"GLO"``, ``"RER"``, ``"RNA"``. name: Optional human-readable name of the location.
